description: I'm a Computer Science and Engineering graduate from Mozambique, passionate about AI, Machine Learning, software development, and data science. I have experience with Python, Java, React, and data analysis. I'm building NYELETI AI to explore satellite data and address environmental challenges. I'm looking for collaborators skilled in GIS, Remote Sensing, AI/ML, Python, and UI/UX design. Let's combine our skills to build innovative solutions with real-world impact!
